nodes.name: Munitions Fabrication
nodes.desc: Onboard slug fabrication brings the railgun online. Fire a round to collapse an active sensor lock, buying distance from the hunters.

nodes.name: Expanded Magazine
nodes.desc: Modular rack units triple the ready magazine, letting you loose far more rounds before a reload.

nodes.name: Rapid Cycler
nodes.desc: Gauss-coil autoloaders halve the firing interval and shave the rounds spent per shot. Cheap, relentless suppression.

nodes.name: Overcharge Cannon
nodes.desc: At the moment a lock turns lethal, the cannon dumps its magazine in a single overcharged burst, scattering the pursuit and dragging you back from the brink.

nodes.name: Antimatter Rounds
nodes.desc: Micro-annihilation warheads make each slug hit far harder, collapsing more of the sensor net per shot.

nodes.name: Warp-Penetrator Barrel
nodes.desc: A miniature Alcubierre bubble sheathes each round in transit. Devastating per shot, but every discharge burns extra ordnance.

nodes.name: Warp-Penetrator Array
nodes.desc: A full warp-lattice barrage severs every tracking solution at once. One volley wipes your detection to nothing.

nodes.name: Signal Dampener Field
nodes.desc: A low emission envelope softens the ship's signature, making each jump less likely to draw a new lock.

nodes.name: Cloak Weave
nodes.desc: Adaptive hull weave sheds residual heat faster, letting an active lock fade twice as quickly between moves.

nodes.name: Phase Lattice
nodes.desc: Interferometric plating scatters incoming scans, further suppressing the odds any jump is noticed.

nodes.name: Phase Cloak
nodes.desc: A full phase cloak folds the ship half out of local spacetime. You move like a ghost, and what little heat you leave bleeds away almost at once.

nodes.name: Deflector Coil
nodes.desc: A charged deflector field soaks up would-be locks, quietly absorbing a rise before it registers. The charge rebuilds over time.

nodes.name: Deflector Array
nodes.desc: Banked deflector emitters deepen the charge reservoir, absorbing far more sensor pressure before it reaches the hull.

nodes.name: Aegis Deflector
nodes.desc: At a lethal lock the Aegis collapses its full charge into a hardened shell, absorbing the strike that would have ended the run.
